notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.notes:
Enhancements:

Added option to change between Fullscreen/Windowed mode

Changed Nailed Games logo in Splash Screen to the updated one

Changed Discoveries descriptions to enhance readability

Changed Alchemy related costs - Alchemy can be utilized in early game

Updated Trajectory Line design - Changed design and animated motion

Updated Resource Views - All resource views will show elements in Alphabetical order, for discovery there is an option to choose between highest to lowest price or alphabetical order

Added Hover description for working moles - when mouse is over the mole in the bottom right corner it will show the name and current level of work
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610935/8a4878d58700d377762784365ece5fa4b2ac0a54.png"]

Increase selling stack limits and tweak on Demand System to provide easier money generation in late game

Fixes:

Fixed bug related to Hook Mole was not able to correctly determine Mined Resources in the corners

Fixed bug about Foundry and Factory Learning Paths, now moles are able to reach highest stats

Fixed collider issue related to Hook Tree, which showed the tree interactive even in cases where it wasn't

Fixed Quest Reward scaling - synchronization was failing between quest scale tracker and elapsed time, which prevented correct quest reward scaling for late game.

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 - Hotfix Update: Background Support Enabled
notes.notes: I've implemented changes to allow the game to continue running in the background. With this update, you can now switch to other windows while your hardworking moles keep building and growing their economy without interruption.

notes.title: Release coming...
notes.notes:
💎 Pickaxes Ready, Wallets Open, Labs Bubbling... 🛠️📈🔬

The vaults are stocked, the gems are polished, and the research notes are only slightly singed — MolEconomy is officially READY for launch on Steam, May 30! 🧪💎💼

Just 11 days left until you can dive into a world of mining, money-making, molecule-mashing, and market chaos! I've been digging deep (both in-game and in real life) to bring this shiny little gem to life, and I seriously can’t wait for you to play it.

I hope you’ll love building your empire, hoarding rare jewels, and probably bankrupting yourself in the name of science. 💸✨

Mark your calendars, charge your research stations, and prepare to become fabulously unstable... economically speaking.
